text: ¶<<A Prayer of David.>> Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, [that goeth] not out of feigned lips. {the right: Heb. justice} {not...: Heb. without lips of deceit}

title: Psalms 17:2
text: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

title: Psalms 17:3
text: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited [me] in the night; thou hast tried me, [and] shalt find nothing; I am purposed [that] my mouth shall not transgress.

title: Psalms 17:4
text: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept [me from] the paths of the destroyer.

title: Psalms 17:5
text: Hold up my goings in thy paths, [that] my footsteps slip not. {slip...: Heb. be not moved}

title: Psalms 17:6
text: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, [and hear] my speech.

title: Psalms 17:7
text: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust [in thee] from those that rise up [against them]. {by thy...: or, them which trust in thee from those that rise up against thy right hand}

title: Psalms 17:8
text: ¶Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

title: Psalms 17:9
text: From the wicked that oppress me, [from] my deadly enemies, [who] compass me about. {oppress: Heb. waste} {my...: Heb. my enemies against the soul}

title: Psalms 17:10
text: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

title: Psalms 17:11
text: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

title: Psalms 17:12
text: Like as a lion [that] is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places. {Like...: Heb. The likeness of him (that is, of every one of them) is as a lion that desireth to ravin} {lurking: Heb. sitting}

title: Psalms 17:13
text: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, [which is] thy sword: {disappoint...: Heb. prevent his face} {which is: or, by}

title: Psalms 17:14
text: From men [which are] thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, [which have] their portion in [this] life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid [treasure]: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their [substance] to their babes. {which are: or, by} {they...: or, their children are full}

title: Psalms 17:15
text: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

title: Psalms 18:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David, the servant of the LORD, who spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day [that] the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: And he said,>> I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

title: Psalms 18:2
text: The LORD [is] my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, [and] my high tower. {my strength: Heb. my rock}

title: Psalms 18:3
text: I will call upon the LORD, [who is worthy] to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

title: Psalms 18:4
text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid. {ungodly men: Heb. Belial}

title: Psalms 18:5
text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me. {sorrows: or, cords}

title: Psalms 18:6
text: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, [even] into his ears.

title: Psalms 18:7
text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

title: Psalms 18:8
text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. {out of his nostrils: Heb. by his, etc}

title: Psalms 18:9
text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness [was] under his feet.

title: Psalms 18:10
text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

title: Psalms 18:11
text: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him [were] dark waters [and] thick clouds of the skies.

title: Psalms 18:12
text: At the brightness [that was] before him his thick clouds passed, hail [stones] and coals of fire.

title: Psalms 18:13
text: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail [stones] and coals of fire.

title: Psalms 18:14
text: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

title: Psalms 18:15
text: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

title: Psalms 18:16
text: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters. {many: or, great}

title: Psalms 18:17
text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

title: Psalms 18:18
text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

title: Psalms 18:19
text: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

title: Psalms 18:20
text: ¶The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

title: Psalms 18:21
text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

title: Psalms 18:22
text: For all his judgments [were] before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

title: Psalms 18:23
text: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity. {before: Heb. with}

title: Psalms 18:24
text: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight. {in...: Heb. before his eyes}

title: Psalms 18:25
text: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

title: Psalms 18:26
text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward. {shew thyself froward: or, wrestle}

title: Psalms 18:27
text: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

title: Psalms 18:28
text: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness. {candle: or, lamp}

title: Psalms 18:29
text: ¶For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall. {run...: or, broken}

title: Psalms 18:30
text: [As for] God, his way [is] perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he [is] a buckler to all those that trust in him. {tried: or, refined}

title: Psalms 18:31
text: For who [is] God save the LORD? or who [is] a rock save our God?

title: Psalms 18:32
text: [It is] God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

title: Psalms 18:33
text: He maketh my feet like hinds' [feet], and setteth me upon my high places.

title: Psalms 18:34
text: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

title: Psalms 18:35
text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great. {thy gentleness...: or, with thy meekness thou hast multiplied me}

title: Psalms 18:36
text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip. {my feet: Heb. mine ankles}

title: Psalms 18:37
text: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

title: Psalms 18:38
text: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

title: Psalms 18:39
text: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me. {subdued: Heb. caused to bow}

title: Psalms 18:40
text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

title: Psalms 18:41
text: They cried, but [there was] none to save [them: even] unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

title: Psalms 18:42
text: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

title: Psalms 18:43
text: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; [and] thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people [whom] I have not known shall serve me.

title: Psalms 18:44
text: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me. {As soon...: Heb. At the hearing of the ear} {submit...: or, yield feigned obedience} {strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger}

title: Psalms 18:45
text: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places. {strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger}

title: Psalms 18:46
text: The LORD liveth; and blessed [be] my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

title: Psalms 18:47
text: [It is] God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me. {avengeth: Heb. giveth avengements for} {subdueth: or, destroyeth}

title: Psalms 18:48
text: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man. {violent...: Heb. man of violence}

title: Psalms 18:49
text: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name. {give...: or, confess}

title: Psalms 18:50
text: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

title: Psalms 19:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

title: Psalms 19:2
text: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

title: Psalms 19:3
text: [There is] no speech nor language, [where] their voice is not heard. {where...: or, without these their voice is heard: Heb. without their voice heard}

title: Psalms 19:4
text: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun, {line: or, rule, or, direction}

title: Psalms 19:5
text: Which [is] as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, [and] rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

title: Psalms 19:6
text: His going forth [is] from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

title: Psalms 19:7
text: ¶The law of the LORD [is] perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD [is] sure, making wise the simple. {law: or, doctrine} {converting: or, restoring}

title: Psalms 19:8
text: The statutes of the LORD [are] right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD [is] pure, enlightening the eyes.

title: Psalms 19:9
text: The fear of the LORD [is] clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD [are] true [and] righteous altogether. {true: Heb. truth}

title: Psalms 19:10
text: More to be desired [are they] than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb. {the honeycomb: Heb. the dropping of honeycombs}

title: Psalms 19:11
text: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: [and] in keeping of them [there is] great reward.

title: Psalms 19:12
text: Who can understand [his] errors? cleanse thou me from secret [faults].

title: Psalms 19:13
text: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous [sins]; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression. {the great: or, much}

title: Psalms 19:14
text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer. {strength: Heb. rock}

title: Psalms 20:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee; {defend...: Heb. set thee on an high place}

title: Psalms 20:2
text: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion; {thee help: Heb. thy help} {strengthen: Heb. support}

title: Psalms 20:3
text: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah. {accept: Heb. turn to ashes: or, make fat}

title: Psalms 20:4
text: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

title: Psalms 20:5
text: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up [our] banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

title: Psalms 20:6
text: ¶Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand. {his holy...: Heb. the heaven of his holiness} {with...: Heb. by the strength of the salvation of}

title: Psalms 20:7
text: Some [trust] in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

title: Psalms 20:8
text: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

title: Psalms 20:9
text: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

title: Psalms 21:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

title: Psalms 21:2
text: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

title: Psalms 21:3
text: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

title: Psalms 21:4
text: He asked life of thee, [and] thou gavest [it] him, [even] length of days for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 21:5
text: His glory [is] great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

title: Psalms 21:6
text: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance. {made him most...: Heb. set him to be blessings} {made him exceeding...: Heb. make him glad with joy}

title: Psalms 21:7
text: ¶For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

title: Psalms 21:8
text: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

title: Psalms 21:9
text: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

title: Psalms 21:10
text: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

title: Psalms 21:11
text: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, [which] they are not able [to perform].

title: Psalms 21:12
text: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, [when] thou shalt make ready [thine arrows] upon thy strings against the face of them. {shalt thou...: or, thou shalt set them as a butt} {back: Heb. shoulder}

title: Psalms 21:13
text: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: [so] will we sing and praise thy power.

title: Psalms 22:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of David.>> My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? [why art thou so] far from helping me, [and from] the words of my roaring? {Aijeleth...: or, the hind of the morning} {helping...: Heb. my salvation}

title: Psalms 22:2
text: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent. {am...: Heb. there is no silence to me}

title: Psalms 22:3
text: But thou [art] holy, [O thou] that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

title: Psalms 22:4
text: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

title: Psalms 22:5
text: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

title: Psalms 22:6
text: But I [am] a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

title: Psalms 22:7
text: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, [saying], {shoot...: Heb. open}

title: Psalms 22:8
text: He trusted on the LORD [that] he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him. {He trusted...: Heb. He rolled himself on} {seeing...: or, if he delight in}

title: Psalms 22:9
text: But thou [art] he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope [when I was] upon my mother's breasts. {didst...: or, kept me in safety}

title: Psalms 22:10
text: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou [art] my God from my mother's belly.

title: Psalms 22:11
text: ¶Be not far from me; for trouble [is] near; for [there is] none to help. {none...: Heb. not a helper}

title: Psalms 22:12
text: Many bulls have compassed me: strong [bulls] of Bashan have beset me round.

title: Psalms 22:13
text: They gaped upon me [with] their mouths, [as] a ravening and a roaring lion. {gaped...: Heb. opened their mouths against me}

title: Psalms 22:14
text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels. {out of...: or, sundered}

title: Psalms 22:15
text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

title: Psalms 22:16
text: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

title: Psalms 22:17
text: I may tell all my bones: they look [and] stare upon me.

title: Psalms 22:18
text: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

title: Psalms 22:19
text: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

title: Psalms 22:20
text: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog. {my darling: Heb. my only one} {power: Heb. hand}

title: Psalms 22:21
text: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

title: Psalms 22:22
text: ¶I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

title: Psalms 22:23
text: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

title: Psalms 22:24
text: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

title: Psalms 22:25
text: My praise [shall be] of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

title: Psalms 22:26
text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

title: Psalms 22:27
text: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

title: Psalms 22:28
text: For the kingdom [is] the LORD'S: and he [is] the governor among the nations.

title: Psalms 22:29
text: All [they that be] fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

title: Psalms 22:30
text: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

title: Psalms 22:31
text: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done [this].

title: Psalms 23:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> The LORD [is] my shepherd; I shall not want.

title: Psalms 23:2
text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. {green...: Heb. pastures of tender grass} {still...: Heb. waters of quietness}

title: Psalms 23:3
text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

title: Psalms 23:4
text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou [art] with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

title: Psalms 23:5
text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over. {anointest: Heb. makest fat}

title: Psalms 23:6
text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever. {for ever: Heb. to length of days}

title: Psalms 24:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> The earth [is] the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

title: Psalms 24:2
text: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

title: Psalms 24:3
text: ¶Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

title: Psalms 24:4
text: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully. {He...: Heb. The clean of hands}

title: Psalms 24:5
text: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

title: Psalms 24:6
text: This [is] the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah. {O Jacob: or, O God of Jacob}

title: Psalms 24:7
text: ¶Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

title: Psalms 24:8
text: Who [is] this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

title: Psalms 24:9
text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift [them] up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

title: Psalms 24:10
text: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he [is] the King of glory. Selah.

title: Psalms 25:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

title: Psalms 25:2
text: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

title: Psalms 25:3
text: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

title: Psalms 25:4
text: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

title: Psalms 25:5
text: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou [art] the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

title: Psalms 25:6
text: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they [have been] ever of old. {tender...: Heb. bowels}

title: Psalms 25:7
text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

title: Psalms 25:8
text: ¶Good and upright [is] the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

title: Psalms 25:9
text: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

title: Psalms 25:10
text: All the paths of the LORD [are] mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

title: Psalms 25:11
text: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it [is] great.

title: Psalms 25:12
text: What man [is] he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way [that] he shall choose.

title: Psalms 25:13
text: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth. {dwell...: Heb. lodge in goodness}

title: Psalms 25:14
text: The secret of the LORD [is] with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant. {and...: or, and his covenant to make them know it}

title: Psalms 25:15
text: ¶Mine eyes [are] ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net. {pluck: Heb. bring forth}

title: Psalms 25:16
text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I [am] desolate and afflicted.

title: Psalms 25:17
text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: [O] bring thou me out of my distresses.

title: Psalms 25:18
text: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

title: Psalms 25:19
text: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred. {cruel...: Heb. hatred of violence}

title: Psalms 25:20
text: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

title: Psalms 25:21
text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

title: Psalms 25:22
text: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

title: Psalms 26:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; [therefore] I shall not slide.

title: Psalms 26:2
text: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

title: Psalms 26:3
text: For thy lovingkindness [is] before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

title: Psalms 26:4
text: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

title: Psalms 26:5
text: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

title: Psalms 26:6
text: ¶I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

title: Psalms 26:7
text: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

title: Psalms 26:8
text: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth. {where...: Heb. of the tabernacle of thy honour}

title: Psalms 26:9
text: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men: {Gather...: or, Take not away} {bloody...: Heb. men of blood}

title: Psalms 26:10
text: In whose hands [is] mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes. {full...: Heb. filled with}

title: Psalms 26:11
text: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

title: Psalms 26:12
text: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.

title: Psalms 27:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> The LORD [is] my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD [is] the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

title: Psalms 27:2
text: When the wicked, [even] mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell. {came...: Heb. approached against me}

title: Psalms 27:3
text: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this [will] I [be] confident.

title: Psalms 27:4
text: One [thing] have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple. {the beauty: or, the delight}

title: Psalms 27:5
text: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

title: Psalms 27:6
text: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD. {joy: Heb. shouting}

title: Psalms 27:7
text: ¶Hear, O LORD, [when] I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

title: Psalms 27:8
text: [When thou saidst], Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek. {When...: or, My heart said unto thee, Let my face seek thy face, etc}

title: Psalms 27:9
text: Hide not thy face [far] from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

title: Psalms 27:10
text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up. {take...: Heb. gather me}

title: Psalms 27:11
text: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies. {a plain...: Heb. a way of plainness} {mine...: Heb. those which observe me}

title: Psalms 27:12
text: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

title: Psalms 27:13
text: [I had fainted], unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

title: Psalms 27:14
text: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

title: Psalms 28:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, [if] thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit. {to me: Heb. from me}

title: Psalms 28:2
text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle. {thy...: or, the oracle of thy sanctuary}

title: Psalms 28:3
text: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief [is] in their hearts.

title: Psalms 28:4
text: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

title: Psalms 28:5
text: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

title: Psalms 28:6
text: ¶Blessed [be] the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

title: Psalms 28:7
text: The LORD [is] my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

title: Psalms 28:8
text: The LORD [is] their strength, and he [is] the saving strength of his anointed. {their: or, his} {saving...: Heb. strength of salvations}

title: Psalms 28:9
text: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever. {feed: or, rule}

title: Psalms 29:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength. {ye mighty: Heb. ye sons of the mighty}

title: Psalms 29:2
text: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness. {the glory...: Heb. the honour of his name} {in...: or, in his glorious sanctuary}

title: Psalms 29:3
text: The voice of the LORD [is] upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD [is] upon many waters. {many: or, great}

title: Psalms 29:4
text: The voice of the LORD [is] powerful; the voice of the LORD [is] full of majesty. {powerful: Heb. in power} {full...: Heb. in majesty}

title: Psalms 29:5
text: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

title: Psalms 29:6
text: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

title: Psalms 29:7
text: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire. {divideth: Heb. cutteth out}

title: Psalms 29:8
text: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

title: Psalms 29:9
text: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of [his] glory. {to calve: or, to be in pain} {doth...: or, every whit of it uttereth, etc}

title: Psalms 29:10
text: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

title: Psalms 29:11
text: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

title: Psalms 30:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm [and] Song [at] the dedication of the house of David.>> I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

title: Psalms 30:2
text: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

title: Psalms 30:3
text: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

title: Psalms 30:4
text: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness. {at...: or, to the memorial}

title: Psalms 30:5
text: For his anger [endureth but] a moment; in his favour [is] life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy [cometh] in the morning. {his anger...: Heb. there is but a moment in his anger} {for a night: Heb. in the evening} {joy: Heb. singing}

title: Psalms 30:6
text: ¶And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

title: Psalms 30:7
text: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, [and] I was troubled. {made...: Heb. settled strength for my mountain}

title: Psalms 30:8
text: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

title: Psalms 30:9
text: What profit [is there] in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

title: Psalms 30:10
text: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.

title: Psalms 30:11
text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

title: Psalms 30:12
text: To the end that [my] glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever. {my glory: that is, my tongue, or, my soul}

title: Psalms 31:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

title: Psalms 31:2
text: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me. {my...: Heb. to me for rock of strength}

title: Psalms 31:3
text: For thou [art] my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

title: Psalms 31:4
text: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou [art] my strength.

title: Psalms 31:5
text: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

title: Psalms 31:6
text: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

title: Psalms 31:7
text: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

title: Psalms 31:8
text: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

title: Psalms 31:9
text: ¶Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, [yea], my soul and my belly.

title: Psalms 31:10
text: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

title: Psalms 31:11
text: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

title: Psalms 31:12
text: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel. {a broken...: Heb. a vessel that perisheth}

title: Psalms 31:13
text: For I have heard the slander of many: fear [was] on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

title: Psalms 31:14
text: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou [art] my God.

title: Psalms 31:15
text: My times [are] in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

title: Psalms 31:16
text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

title: Psalms 31:17
text: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, [and] let them be silent in the grave. {silent...: or, cut off for}

title: Psalms 31:18
text: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous. {grievous...: Heb. a hard thing}

title: Psalms 31:19
text: ¶[Oh] how great [is] thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; [which] thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

title: Psalms 31:20
text: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

title: Psalms 31:21
text: Blessed [be] the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city. {strong: or, fenced}

title: Psalms 31:22
text: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

title: Psalms 31:23
text: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: [for] the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

title: Psalms 31:24
text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

title: Psalms 32:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David, Maschil.>> Blessed [is he whose] transgression [is] forgiven, [whose] sin [is] covered. {A Psalm...: or, A Psalm of David giving instruction}

title: Psalms 32:2
text: Blessed [is] the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit [there is] no guile.

title: Psalms 32:3
text: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

title: Psalms 32:4
text: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

title: Psalms 32:5
text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

title: Psalms 32:6
text: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him. {when...: Heb. of finding}

title: Psalms 32:7
text: ¶Thou [art] my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

title: Psalms 32:8
text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye. {guide...: Heb. counsel thee, mine eye shall be upon thee}

title: Psalms 32:9
text: Be ye not as the horse, [or] as the mule, [which] have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

title: Psalms 32:10
text: Many sorrows [shall be] to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.

title: Psalms 32:11
text: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all [ye that are] upright in heart.

title: Psalms 33:1
text: ¶Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: [for] praise is comely for the upright.

title: Psalms 33:2
text: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery [and] an instrument of ten strings.

title: Psalms 33:3
text: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

title: Psalms 33:4
text: For the word of the LORD [is] right; and all his works [are done] in truth.

title: Psalms 33:5
text: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD. {goodness: or, mercy}

title: Psalms 33:6
text: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

title: Psalms 33:7
text: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

title: Psalms 33:8
text: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

title: Psalms 33:9
text: For he spake, and it was [done]; he commanded, and it stood fast.

title: Psalms 33:10
text: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect. {bringeth: Heb. maketh frustrate}

title: Psalms 33:11
text: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations. {to all...: Heb. to generation and generation}

title: Psalms 33:12
text: ¶Blessed [is] the nation whose God [is] the LORD; [and] the people [whom] he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

title: Psalms 33:13
text: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

title: Psalms 33:14
text: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

title: Psalms 33:15
text: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

title: Psalms 33:16
text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

title: Psalms 33:17
text: An horse [is] a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver [any] by his great strength.

title: Psalms 33:18
text: Behold, the eye of the LORD [is] upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

title: Psalms 33:19
text: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

title: Psalms 33:20
text: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he [is] our help and our shield.

title: Psalms 33:21
text: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

title: Psalms 33:22
text: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

title: Psalms 34:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.>> I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise [shall] continually [be] in my mouth. {Abimelech: or, Achish}

title: Psalms 34:2
text: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear [thereof], and be glad.

title: Psalms 34:3
text: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

title: Psalms 34:4
text: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

title: Psalms 34:5
text: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed. {were lightened: or, they flowed unto him}

title: Psalms 34:6
text: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard [him], and saved him out of all his troubles.

title: Psalms 34:7
text: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

title: Psalms 34:8
text: O taste and see that the LORD [is] good: blessed [is] the man [that] trusteth in him.

title: Psalms 34:9
text: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for [there is] no want to them that fear him.

title: Psalms 34:10
text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good [thing].

title: Psalms 34:11
text: ¶Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

title: Psalms 34:12
text: What man [is he that] desireth life, [and] loveth [many] days, that he may see good?

title: Psalms 34:13
text: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

title: Psalms 34:14
text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

title: Psalms 34:15
text: The eyes of the LORD [are] upon the righteous, and his ears [are open] unto their cry.

title: Psalms 34:16
text: The face of the LORD [is] against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

title: Psalms 34:17
text: [The righteous] cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

title: Psalms 34:18
text: The LORD [is] nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit. {unto...: Heb. to the broken of heart} {of a contrite...: Heb. contrite of spirit}

title: Psalms 34:19
text: Many [are] the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

title: Psalms 34:20
text: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

title: Psalms 34:21
text: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate. {desolate: or, guilty}

title: Psalms 34:22
text: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate. {desolate: or, guilty}

title: Psalms 35:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Plead [my cause], O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

title: Psalms 35:2
text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

title: Psalms 35:3
text: Draw out also the spear, and stop [the way] against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I [am] thy salvation.

title: Psalms 35:4
text: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

title: Psalms 35:5
text: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase [them].

title: Psalms 35:6
text: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them. {dark...: Heb. darkness and slipperiness}

title: Psalms 35:7
text: For without cause have they hid for me their net [in] a pit, [which] without cause they have digged for my soul.

title: Psalms 35:8
text: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall. {at...: Heb. which he knoweth not of}

title: Psalms 35:9
text: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

title: Psalms 35:10
text: All my bones shall say, LORD, who [is] like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

title: Psalms 35:11
text: ¶False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge [things] that I knew not. {False...: Heb. Witnesses of wrong} {they...: Heb. they asked me}

title: Psalms 35:12
text: They rewarded me evil for good [to] the spoiling of my soul. {spoiling: Heb. depriving}

title: Psalms 35:13
text: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing [was] sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom. {humbled: or, afflicted}

title: Psalms 35:14
text: I behaved myself as though [he had been] my friend [or] brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth [for his] mother. {behaved myself: Heb. walked} {as though...: Heb. as a friend, as a brother to me}

title: Psalms 35:15
text: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: [yea], the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew [it] not; they did tear [me], and ceased not: {adversity: Heb. halting}

title: Psalms 35:16
text: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

title: Psalms 35:17
text: ¶Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions. {darling: Heb. only one}

title: Psalms 35:18
text: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people. {much: Heb. strong}

title: Psalms 35:19
text: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: [neither] let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause. {wrongfully: Heb. falsely}

title: Psalms 35:20
text: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against [them that are] quiet in the land.

title: Psalms 35:21
text: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, [and] said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen [it].

title: Psalms 35:22
text: [This] thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

title: Psalms 35:23
text: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, [even] unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

title: Psalms 35:24
text: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

title: Psalms 35:25
text: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up. {Ah...: Heb. Ah, ah, our soul}

title: Psalms 35:26
text: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify [themselves] against me.

title: Psalms 35:27
text: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant. {righteous...: Heb. righteousness}

title: Psalms 35:28
text: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness [and] of thy praise all the day long.

title: Psalms 36:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD.>> The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, [that there is] no fear of God before his eyes.

title: Psalms 36:2
text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful. {until...: Heb. to find his iniquity to hate}

title: Psalms 36:3
text: The words of his mouth [are] iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, [and] to do good.

title: Psalms 36:4
text: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way [that is] not good; he abhorreth not evil. {mischief: or, vanity}

title: Psalms 36:5
text: ¶Thy mercy, O LORD, [is] in the heavens; [and] thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the clouds.

title: Psalms 36:6
text: Thy righteousness [is] like the great mountains; thy judgments [are] a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast. {the...: Heb. the mountains of God}

title: Psalms 36:7
text: How excellent [is] thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings. {excellent: Heb. precious}

title: Psalms 36:8
text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures. {abundantly...: Heb. watered}

title: Psalms 36:9
text: For with thee [is] the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

title: Psalms 36:10
text: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart. {continue: Heb. draw out at length}

title: Psalms 36:11
text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

title: Psalms 36:12
text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

title: Psalms 37:1
text: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

title: Psalms 37:2
text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

title: Psalms 37:3
text: Trust in the LORD, and do good; [so] shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed. {verily: Heb. in truth, or, stableness}

title: Psalms 37:4
text: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

title: Psalms 37:5
text: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring [it] to pass. {Commit...: Heb. Roll thy way upon}

title: Psalms 37:6
text: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

title: Psalms 37:7
text: ¶Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass. {Rest in: Heb. Be silent to}

title: Psalms 37:8
text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

title: Psalms 37:9
text: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

title: Psalms 37:10
text: For yet a little while, and the wicked [shall] not [be]: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it [shall] not [be].

title: Psalms 37:11
text: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

title: Psalms 37:12
text: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth. {plotteth: or, practiseth}

title: Psalms 37:13
text: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

title: Psalms 37:14
text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, [and] to slay such as be of upright conversation. {such...: Heb. the upright of way}

title: Psalms 37:15
text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

title: Psalms 37:16
text: A little that a righteous man hath [is] better than the riches of many wicked.

title: Psalms 37:17
text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

title: Psalms 37:18
text: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

title: Psalms 37:19
text: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

title: Psalms 37:20
text: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD [shall be] as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away. {the fat: Heb. the preciousness}

title: Psalms 37:21
text: ¶The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

title: Psalms 37:22
text: For [such as be] blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and [they that be] cursed of him shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:23
text: The steps of a [good] man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way. {ordered: or, established}

title: Psalms 37:24
text: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth [him with] his hand.

title: Psalms 37:25
text: I have been young, and [now] am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

title: Psalms 37:26
text: [He is] ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed [is] blessed. {ever: Heb. all the day}

title: Psalms 37:27
text: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

title: Psalms 37:28
text: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:29
text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

title: Psalms 37:30
text: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

title: Psalms 37:31
text: The law of his God [is] in his heart; none of his steps shall slide. {steps: or, goings}

title: Psalms 37:32
text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

title: Psalms 37:33
text: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

title: Psalms 37:34
text: ¶Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see [it].

title: Psalms 37:35
text: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree. {a green...: or, a green tree that groweth in his own soil}

title: Psalms 37:36
text: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he [was] not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

title: Psalms 37:37
text: Mark the perfect [man], and behold the upright: for the end of [that] man [is] peace.

title: Psalms 37:38
text: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

title: Psalms 37:39
text: But the salvation of the righteous [is] of the LORD: [he is] their strength in the time of trouble.

title: Psalms 37:40
text: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

title: Psalms 38:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.>> O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

title: Psalms 38:2
text: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

title: Psalms 38:3
text: [There is] no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither [is there any] rest in my bones because of my sin. {rest: Heb. peace, or, health}

title: Psalms 38:4
text: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

title: Psalms 38:5
text: My wounds stink [and] are corrupt because of my foolishness.

title: Psalms 38:6
text: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long. {troubled: Heb. wried}

title: Psalms 38:7
text: For my loins are filled with a loathsome [disease]: and [there is] no soundness in my flesh.

title: Psalms 38:8
text: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

title: Psalms 38:9
text: Lord, all my desire [is] before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

title: Psalms 38:10
text: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me. {is gone...: Heb. is not with me}

title: Psalms 38:11
text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off. {sore: Heb. stroke} {my kinsmen: or, my neighbours}

title: Psalms 38:12
text: ¶They also that seek after my life lay snares [for me]: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

title: Psalms 38:13
text: But I, as a deaf [man], heard not; and [I was] as a dumb man [that] openeth not his mouth.

title: Psalms 38:14
text: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth [are] no reproofs.

title: Psalms 38:15
text: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God. {in...: or, thee do I wait for} {hear: or, answer}

title: Psalms 38:16
text: For I said, [Hear me], lest [otherwise] they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify [themselves] against me.

title: Psalms 38:17
text: For I [am] ready to halt, and my sorrow [is] continually before me. {to halt: Heb. for halting}

title: Psalms 38:18
text: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

title: Psalms 38:19
text: But mine enemies [are] lively, [and] they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied. {are lively...: Heb. being living, are strong}

title: Psalms 38:20
text: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow [the thing that] good [is].

title: Psalms 38:21
text: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.

title: Psalms 38:22
text: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation. {to...: Heb. for my help}

title: Psalms 39:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, [even] to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.>> I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me. {my mouth...: Heb. a bridle, or, muzzle for my mouth}

title: Psalms 39:2
text: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, [even] from good; and my sorrow was stirred. {stirred: Heb. troubled}

title: Psalms 39:3
text: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: [then] spake I with my tongue,

title: Psalms 39:4
text: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it [is; that] I may know how frail I [am]. {how...: or, what time I have here}

title: Psalms 39:5
text: Behold, thou hast made my days [as] an handbreadth; and mine age [is] as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state [is] altogether vanity. Selah. {at...: Heb. settled}

title: Psalms 39:6
text: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up [riches], and knoweth not who shall gather them. {a vain...: Heb. an image}

title: Psalms 39:7
text: ¶And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope [is] in thee.

title: Psalms 39:8
text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

title: Psalms 39:9
text: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst [it].

title: Psalms 39:10
text: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand. {blow: Heb. conflict}

title: Psalms 39:11
text: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man [is] vanity. Selah. {his...: Heb. that which is to be desired in him to melt away}

title: Psalms 39:12
text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I [am] a stranger with thee, [and] a sojourner, as all my fathers [were].

title: Psalms 39:13
text: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

title: Psalms 40:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry. {I waited...: Heb. In waiting I waited}

title: Psalms 40:2
text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, [and] established my goings. {an...: Heb. a pit of noise}

title: Psalms 40:3
text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, [even] praise unto our God: many shall see [it], and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

title: Psalms 40:4
text: Blessed [is] that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

title: Psalms 40:5
text: Many, O LORD my God, [are] thy wonderful works [which] thou hast done, and thy thoughts [which are] to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: [if] I would declare and speak [of them], they are more than can be numbered. {they cannot...: or, none can order them unto thee}

title: Psalms 40:6
text: ¶Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required. {opened: Heb. digged}

title: Psalms 40:7
text: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book [it is] written of me,

title: Psalms 40:8
text: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law [is] within my heart. {within...: Heb. in the midst of my bowels}

title: Psalms 40:9
text: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

title: Psalms 40:10
text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

title: Psalms 40:11
text: ¶Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

title: Psalms 40:12
text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me. {falleth: Heb. forsaketh}

title: Psalms 40:13
text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

title: Psalms 40:14
text: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

title: Psalms 40:15
text: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

title: Psalms 40:16
text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

title: Psalms 40:17
text: But I [am] poor and needy; [yet] the Lord thinketh upon me: thou [art] my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

title: Psalms 41:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> Blessed [is] he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble. {the poor: or, the weak, or, sick} {in time...: Heb. in the day of evil}

title: Psalms 41:2
text: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; [and] he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies. {thou...: or, do not thou deliver}

title: Psalms 41:3
text: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness. {make: Heb. turn}

title: Psalms 41:4
text: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

title: Psalms 41:5
text: ¶Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

title: Psalms 41:6
text: And if he come to see [me], he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; [when] he goeth abroad, he telleth [it].

title: Psalms 41:7
text: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt. {my...: Heb. evil to me}

title: Psalms 41:8
text: An evil disease, [say they], cleaveth fast unto him: and [now] that he lieth he shall rise up no more. {An...: Heb. A thing of Belial}

title: Psalms 41:9
text: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up [his] heel against me. {mine...: Heb. the man of my peace} {lifted...: Heb. magnified}

title: Psalms 41:10
text: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

title: Psalms 41:11
text: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

title: Psalms 41:12
text: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

title: Psalms 41:13
text: Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

title: Psalms 42:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.>> As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God. {Maschil...: or, A Psalm giving instruction of the sons, etc} {panteth: Heb. brayeth}

title: Psalms 42:2
text: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

title: Psalms 42:3
text: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where [is] thy God?

title: Psalms 42:4
text: When I remember these [things], I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

title: Psalms 42:5
text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and [why] art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him [for] the help of his countenance. {cast: Heb. bowed} {praise: or, give thanks} {for the...: or, his presence is salvation}

title: Psalms 42:6
text: ¶O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar. {the hill...: or, the little hill}

title: Psalms 42:7
text: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

title: Psalms 42:8
text: [Yet] the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song [shall be] with me, [and] my prayer unto the God of my life.

title: Psalms 42:9
text: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

title: Psalms 42:10
text: [As] with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where [is] thy God? {sword: or, killing}

title: Psalms 42:11
text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.

title: Psalms 43:1
text: ¶Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man. {ungodly: or, unmerciful} {the deceitful...: Heb. a man of deceit and iniquity}

title: Psalms 43:2
text: For thou [art] the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

title: Psalms 43:3
text: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

title: Psalms 43:4
text: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God. {my exceeding...: Heb. the gladness of my joy}

title: Psalms 43:5
text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.

title: Psalms 44:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.>> We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, [what] work thou didst in their days, in the times of old. {Maschil: or, of instruction}

title: Psalms 44:2
text: [How] thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; [how] thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

title: Psalms 44:3
text: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

title: Psalms 44:4
text: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

title: Psalms 44:5
text: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

title: Psalms 44:6
text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

title: Psalms 44:7
text: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

title: Psalms 44:8
text: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

title: Psalms 44:9
text: ¶But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

title: Psalms 44:10
text: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

title: Psalms 44:11
text: Thou hast given us like sheep [appointed] for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen. {like...: Heb. as sheep of meat}

title: Psalms 44:12
text: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase [thy wealth] by their price. {for...: Heb. without riches}

title: Psalms 44:13
text: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

title: Psalms 44:14
text: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

title: Psalms 44:15
text: My confusion [is] continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

title: Psalms 44:16
text: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

title: Psalms 44:17
text: ¶All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

title: Psalms 44:18
text: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way; {steps: or, goings}

title: Psalms 44:19
text: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

title: Psalms 44:20
text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

title: Psalms 44:21
text: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

title: Psalms 44:22
text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

title: Psalms 44:23
text: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast [us] not off for ever.

title: Psalms 44:24
text: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, [and] forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

title: Psalms 44:25
text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

title: Psalms 44:26
text: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake. {for our...: Heb. a help for us}

title: Psalms 45:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.>> My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue [is] the pen of a ready writer. {Maschil: or, of instruction} {is inditing: Heb. boileth, or, bubbleth up}

title: Psalms 45:2
text: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

title: Psalms 45:3
text: Gird thy sword upon [thy] thigh, O [most] mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

title: Psalms 45:4
text: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things. {ride...: Heb. prosper thou, ride thou}

title: Psalms 45:5
text: Thine arrows [are] sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; [whereby] the people fall under thee.

title: Psalms 45:6
text: ¶Thy throne, O God, [is] for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom [is] a right sceptre.

title: Psalms 45:7
text: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

title: Psalms 45:8
text: All thy garments [smell] of myrrh, and aloes, [and] cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

title: Psalms 45:9
text: Kings' daughters [were] among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

title: Psalms 45:10
text: ¶Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;

title: Psalms 45:11
text: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he [is] thy Lord; and worship thou him.

title: Psalms 45:12
text: And the daughter of Tyre [shall be there] with a gift; [even] the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour. {favour: Heb. face}

title: Psalms 45:13
text: The king's daughter [is] all glorious within: her clothing [is] of wrought gold.

title: Psalms 45:14
text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

title: Psalms 45:15
text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.

title: Psalms 45:16
text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

title: Psalms 45:17
text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

title: Psalms 46:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.>> God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. {for: or, of}

title: Psalms 46:2
text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea; {midst...: Heb. heart of the seas}

title: Psalms 46:3
text: [Though] the waters thereof roar [and] be troubled, [though] the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

title: Psalms 46:4
text: [There is] a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy [place] of the tabernacles of the most High.

title: Psalms 46:5
text: God [is] in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, [and that] right early. {and...: Heb. when the morning appeareth}

title: Psalms 46:6
text: ¶The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

title: Psalms 46:7
text: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah. {our...: Heb. an high place for us}

title: Psalms 46:8
text: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

title: Psalms 46:9
text: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

title: Psalms 46:10
text: Be still, and know that I [am] God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

title: Psalms 46:11
text: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah.

title: Psalms 47:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.>> O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph. {for: or, of}

title: Psalms 47:2
text: For the LORD most high [is] terrible; [he is] a great King over all the earth.

title: Psalms 47:3
text: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

title: Psalms 47:4
text: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

title: Psalms 47:5
text: ¶God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

title: Psalms 47:6
text: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

title: Psalms 47:7
text: For God [is] the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding. {with: or, every one that hath}

title: Psalms 47:8
text: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

title: Psalms 47:9
text: The princes of the people are gathered together, [even] the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth [belong] unto God: he is greatly exalted. {princes...: or, voluntary of the people are gathered unto the people of the God of Abraham}

title: Psalms 48:1
text: ¶<<A Song [and] Psalm for the sons of Korah.>> Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, [in] the mountain of his holiness. {for: or, of}

title: Psalms 48:2
text: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, [is] mount Zion, [on] the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

title: Psalms 48:3
text: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

title: Psalms 48:4
text: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

title: Psalms 48:5
text: They saw [it, and] so they marvelled; they were troubled, [and] hasted away.

title: Psalms 48:6
text: Fear took hold upon them there, [and] pain, as of a woman in travail.

title: Psalms 48:7
text: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

title: Psalms 48:8
text: ¶As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

title: Psalms 48:9
text: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

title: Psalms 48:10
text: According to thy name, O God, so [is] thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

title: Psalms 48:11
text: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

title: Psalms 48:12
text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

title: Psalms 48:13
text: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell [it] to the generation following. {Mark...: Heb. Set your heart to} {consider: or, raise up}

title: Psalms 48:14
text: For this God [is] our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide [even] unto death.

title: Psalms 49:1
text: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.>> Hear this, all [ye] people; give ear, all [ye] inhabitants of the world: {for: or, of}

title: Psalms 49:2
text: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

title: Psalms 49:3
text: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart [shall be] of understanding.

title: Psalms 49:4
text: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

title: Psalms 49:5
text: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, [when] the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

title: Psalms 49:6
text: ¶They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

title: Psalms 49:7
text: None [of them] can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

title: Psalms 49:8
text: (For the redemption of their soul [is] precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

title: Psalms 49:9
text: That he should still live for ever, [and] not see corruption.

title: Psalms 49:10
text: For he seeth [that] wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

title: Psalms 49:11
text: Their inward thought [is, that] their houses [shall continue] for ever, [and] their dwelling places to all generations; they call [their] lands after their own names. {all...: Heb. generation and generation}

title: Psalms 49:12
text: Nevertheless man [being] in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts [that] perish.

title: Psalms 49:13
text: This their way [is] their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah. {approve...: Heb. delight in their mouth}

title: Psalms 49:14
text: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling. {beauty: or, strength} {in the grave from...: or, the grave being an habitation to every one of them}

title: Psalms 49:15
text: ¶But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah. {power: Heb. hand} {the grave: or, hell}

title: Psalms 49:16
text: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

title: Psalms 49:17
text: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

title: Psalms 49:18
text: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and [men] will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself. {while...: Heb. in his life}

title: Psalms 49:19
text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light. {He...: Heb. The soul shall}

title: Psalms 49:20
text: Man [that is] in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts [that] perish.

title: Psalms 50:1
text: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> The mighty God, [even] the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof. {of...: or, for Asaph}

title: Psalms 50:2
text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

title: Psalms 50:3
